description: This file contains test functions for testing the NASAs Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) API endpoints using pytest. The tests cover various API behaviors such as health check, fetching today's APOD, fetching by valid/invalid dates, optional parameters, caching behavior, and error handling.

methods.name: test_health(client)
methods.description: Tests the health endpoint (root URL) to ensure it returns a 200 status code and a JSON dict.

methods.name: test_get_apod_today(client)
methods.description: Tests retrieving the APOD for today, checking for 200 response and presence of 'title', 'date', 'url' keys in the JSON response.

methods.name: test_get_apod_by_date_valid(client)
methods.description: Tests fetching APOD for a specific valid date and verifies the date in response matches the requested date.

methods.name: test_get_apod_invalid_date(client)
methods.description: Tests API response when given an invalid date parameter; expects 400 or 422 status codes.

methods.name: test_recent_days_param_optional(client)
methods.description: Tests that optional parameter for recent days still allows accessing the API endpoint successfully.

methods.name: test_cache_hit_and_miss_simulation(client)
methods.description: Simulates cache behavior by requesting the same date twice and verifying the response contains consistent data.

methods.name: test_upstream_failure_simulated(monkeypatch, client)
methods.description: Simulates an upstream failure or invalid input to verify API handles errors properly.
